description: Tahoe-pattern AEAD ciphertext envelope on AT Protocol MST. Plaintext is an arbitrary CBOR-encoded record (typically an inner-lexicon body). The CID over this envelope inherits the MST verify-cap and L2 anchor finality from ADR-2605172000. Read-cap = symmetric key (XChaCha20-Poly1305) distributed via com.etzhayyim.encrypted.keyWrap. Per ADR-2605181100.

nonce.description: AEAD nonce, unique per record. 24 bytes for XChaCha20-Poly1305.

ciphertext.description: AEAD ciphertext over CBOR(plaintext). AAD MUST bind the record's own CID to prevent intra-MST swap attacks.

innerType.description: Lexicon NSID describing the plaintext body shape after decryption. Optional metadata for routing/UI; not authoritative until plaintext is decoded and validated.

keyId.description: Hash prefix (base32 hex, first 16 chars) of the symmetric key. Recipients use this to locate the matching com.etzhayyim.encrypted.keyWrap record in their own PDS.

pad.description: Padding scheme applied to plaintext before AEAD. Omitted = no padding. Per ADR-2605181200.

sender.description: DID that authored this encrypted record. Verifiable against the PDS commit signature.

ciphertextBlob.description: Out-of-line ciphertext for payloads larger than the inline 1 MiB limit. If set, the inline ciphertext field is empty and decryption reads the IPFS-pinned blob instead.
